decided_by: Alexander Kell (architect), AD-287; delegated to the manager 2026-11-03
rationale: AD-287 adds archkeel view show. The UML target of render_architecture_pages gains the keyword view_check, so the main page can embed the view check result. The calls_unresolved budget rises from 824 to 829: the check and show subcommands add four argparse calls the analyzer cannot resolve (eight new, four removed), and the embedded result adds one str.replace on an optional text.
